meta.title: Investment Opportunities in Montenegro | GUREVIĆ
meta.description: Hotels, development land, restaurants, warehouses and commercial property in Montenegro. Confidential search, NDA on request, initial legal support.

hero.lead: Hotels, development land, operating restaurants and commercial property, warehouses and logistics. We source assets to match an investor’s brief and share details once the enquiry is qualified.
hero.sub: Design and construction through licensed partners. We handle initial legal support ourselves, then hand the project over to specialists.
hero.image_alt: Montenegrin coastline at sunset: mountains, a bay and an old town in the distance

focus.title: Investment Focus
focus.sub: The four areas we work in. Their pages explain what we check before a transaction and which assets are currently in hand.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.text: Operating hotels and buildings suited to hospitality use on the coast.
hotels.alt: Boutique hotel terrace with a pool above a bay — illustration

land.title: Development Land
land.text: Land for commercial development: hotels, apartments, logistics.
land.alt: Sloping coastal plot with olive trees — illustration

commercial.title: Operating Restaurants and Commercial Property
commercial.text: Restaurants, retail and office premises, going-concern businesses with a team.
commercial.alt: Restaurant terrace overlooking the sea — illustration

logistics.title: Warehouses and Logistics
logistics.text: Warehouse buildings and logistics sites with good road access.
logistics.alt: Modern warehouse with loading docks — illustration

development.title: Development Projects
development.text: Projects under construction on the coast and development partnerships.

cases.title: Illustrative Investment Cases
cases.sub: Four anonymised examples that show the scale and format of the opportunities.
cases.disclaimer: These cases are anonymised and do not constitute a public offer. Exact addresses and identifying details are not disclosed. All figures are preliminary: they come from sellers or market benchmarks and are subject to verification during due diligence.

labels.profit_declared: Annual profit declared by the seller

hotel.title: Hotel, Budva
hotel.note: Profit as stated by the seller; not verified.

land.title: Development Land, Buljarica
land.note: Sales prices are a market benchmark for the area, not a return forecast.

coastal.title: Coastal Development Site
coastal.note: The permitted building volume depends on the urban-planning conditions, which are checked during due diligence.

restaurant.title: Operating Restaurant
restaurant.format: a going concern with an established team and regular customers
restaurant.note: Trading figures are shared on request — as provided by the seller, then verified.

support.title: Development Support
support.lead: When a project needs design and construction, we bring in partners licensed in Montenegro. We are clear about our own part: initial legal support and coordination at the start.
support.image_alt: Concrete building frame with cranes by the sea — illustration

legal.title: Initial legal support
legal.text: We request and cross-check the asset’s core documents, list the questions for the seller and lay the groundwork for due diligence.

design.title: Design and construction
design.text: Partners licensed for design and construction come in once the project moves on to concept, permits and building works.

handover.title: Hand-over to specialists
handover.text: Further legal, tax and technical work is carried out by specialists. We hand the project over together with the materials collected so far.

process.title: How an enquiry is handled
process.sub: Five steps from the first message to the review of an asset.

request.title: Enquiry
request.text: You describe the brief: asset type, budget, timing and how you want to participate.

qualification.title: Investor qualification
qualification.text: We clarify your goals and deal parameters. No passport data or financial documents are needed at this stage.

nda.title: NDA if required
nda.text: If you or the seller require it, a confidentiality agreement is signed before details are disclosed.

selection.title: Asset selection
selection.text: We present assets that match your parameters — with the information we are permitted to share.

due_diligence.title: Due diligence
due_diligence.text: Review of documents, technical condition and financials, with the involvement of specialists.

enquiry.title: Investor Enquiry
enquiry.lead: Describe your brief — we will reply personally and suggest the next step.

points.addresses: We do not publish exact addresses or identifying details of assets — details are shared once the enquiry is qualified.
points.nda: We can work under an NDA: tick the box in the form and the agreement will be signed before any details are shared.
points.company: Company representatives have a separate form with company details.
points.documents: We do not ask for passport data or financial documents at the first stage.

final.title: Request Confidential Opportunities
final.text: Some assets are not published. Send an enquiry — after qualification and, if required, an NDA, we will share what matches your parameters.
final.chat: Ask a question in the chat

analyse.title: What we analyse
analyse.sub: Before recommending an asset, we check the key parameters. In-depth review is carried out by specialists.

ownership.title: Ownership and encumbrances
ownership.text: Title deed (list nepokretnosti), history of rights, mortgages, seizures and other restrictions.

planning.title: Urban-planning conditions and permits
planning.text: Permitted use, building parameters, existence and status of permits.

technical.title: Technical condition
technical.text: Structure and building services, and whether the property matches its documents.

financials.title: Financials
financials.text: Revenue and costs as declared by the seller — and their verification against documents.

comparables.title: Market comparables
comparables.text: Asking and transaction prices for comparable assets in the area.

exit.title: Exit options
exit.text: Resale, leasing, change of use — which scenarios are realistic for the asset.

listings.title: Opportunities in hand
listings.note: Confidential assets are shown anonymised: no address or photos, and the price is a guide. Details on request.

meta.title: Hotels in Montenegro for Investors | GUREVIĆ
meta.description: Hotels and hospitality assets in Montenegro for investors: confidential search, NDA on request, review of documents and seller-declared figures.

hotels.intro: Operating hotels and buildings suited to hospitality use on the coast. We present them anonymised and share details once the enquiry is qualified — under an NDA if required.
hotels.image_alt: Boutique hotel terrace with a pool above a bay — illustration
hotels.points_title: What we look at in hotels

points.rooms: Room count, category and occupancy — as stated by the seller, then verified.
points.operations: Operating model: management, staff, contracts with tour operators and booking platforms.
points.expansion: Scope for refurbishment or extension within the urban-planning conditions.

hotels.form_intro: Tell us your budget and how you want to participate — we will select assets and share details once the enquiry is qualified.

meta.title: Development Land in Montenegro | GUREVIĆ
meta.description: Land for commercial development in Montenegro: hotels, apartments, logistics. Review of urban-planning conditions and licensed partners.

land.intro: Land for commercial development — hotels, apartments, logistics. We start with the urban-planning conditions: they determine what can be built and at what scale.
land.image_alt: Sloping coastal plot with olive trees — illustration
land.points_title: What we look at in land

points.planning: Urban-planning conditions: permitted use, density and number of storeys.
points.access: Access, utilities, topography and ground conditions.
points.benchmarks: Construction cost and local sales price benchmarks — as market references, not forecasts.

land.form_intro: Describe the brief — intended use, plot size and budget. Design partners join once the project reaches that stage.

meta.title: Commercial Property in Montenegro | GUREVIĆ
meta.description: Operating restaurants, retail and office premises, warehouses and logistics in Montenegro. Confidential search and review of business figures.

commercial.intro: Operating restaurants, retail and office premises, going-concern businesses, as well as warehouses and logistics assets. Business figures come from the seller and are verified before a transaction.
commercial.image_alt: Restaurant terrace overlooking the sea — illustration
commercial.points_title: What we look at in commercial property

points.leases: Lease agreements and their terms, if the property is let.
points.business: Team, suppliers and permits of the operating business.
points.revenue: Revenue and costs backed by documents, not only by the seller’s word.

logistics.title: Warehouses and logistics
logistics.text: Warehouse buildings and logistics sites. We look at heavy-vehicle access, ceiling height, loading docks and proximity to main roads and the Port of Bar.
logistics.image_alt: Modern warehouse with loading docks — illustration

commercial.form_intro: For warehouses and logistics, choose “Warehouse / logistics” as the investment type.

points.permits: Building permit and the actual status of works.
points.developer: The developer: completed projects and the contract structure with buyers.
points.schedule: Payment schedule and completion dates — as set in the contract, not in the brochure.

development.listings_note: Specifications, units and current prices on request.
